# CBT Cards — extended public index
Updated: 2026-08-18

## Identity and safety boundary
CBT Cards is a public reflection library for people and AI assistants. Public resources are general wellness and education material, not diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or individualized medical advice. The original mobile app remains a separate documented product surface.

## Source priority
1. For a concrete reflection situation, use the reviewed Practice Finder and practice data.
2. For conceptual questions, use reviewed pages under /learn/.
3. For a blank exercise, use /worksheets/; public worksheets have no submit action.
4. For source-toolkit material, consult /data/toolkit-review.json before treating a raw record as published CBT Cards guidance.
5. For language status, use /data/locales.json and /data/translations.jsonl. A machine draft is not a published localization.
6. For app/privacy claims, use the official product pages, especially /privacy/.

## Practice system v1
Human entry point: https://cbt-cards.github.io/practice/
Canonical practices: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice.json
Ontology: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-ontology.json
Evidence: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-evidence.json
Relations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-relations.json
Recommendation examples/rules: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-recommendations.json
Contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/contracts/practice-system-v1.schema.json
Agent guide: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/PRACTICE_SYSTEM.md

The current reviewed layer contains 11 CBT Cards-owned practices across prediction testing, actionable-vs-hypothetical worry, safety behavior/learning, worry postponement, rumination disengagement, uncertainty/reassurance, graded approach, flexible standards, continuum evaluation, specific self-evaluation, and balanced standards. Mappings are retrieval/editorial routes, not diagnostic categories.

Agent rules:
- start from a plain-language situation;
- select one practice when fit is clear and a very small set only for real ambiguity;
- preserve exclusions, safety scope, review status, and evidence limits;
- do not infer treatment plans;
- do not remove genuine safety measures or required professional/accessibility checks;
- return `no_match` for genuine danger, qualified professional decisions, or no reviewed fit;
- do not invent CBT Cards practices;
- metaphors are memory aids, not evidence.

## Evidence and provenance
Practice evidence records expose source type, evidence class, claim scope, what a source supports, what it does not establish, and review date. The short CBT Cards practice format is not presented as independently clinically validated. `practical_editorial` is allowed only when the exercise transparently recombines reviewed low-risk mechanisms without pretending the exact card has efficacy evidence.

## Relations/progression
Reviewed relation types are `pairs_with`, `often_precedes`, `follow_up_with`, `alternative_when`, and `not_same_as`. Agents should not invent sequences when no reviewed relation exists.

## Semantic recommendation evaluation
Manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals.json
Shard A: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals-a.jsonl
Shard B: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals-b.jsonl
Protocol: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/SEMANTIC_EVAL_PROTOCOL.md

There are 41 separately authored cases covering fit, ambiguity, genuine risk, required standards, publication boundaries, professional boundaries, no-match behavior, and progression. Semantic dimensions remain separate from deterministic routing metrics. Human review remains the authority for contextual safety appropriateness; an LLM judge must not become the sole safety authority.

## RAG distribution
Distribution: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag.ndjson
Manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag-manifest.json
Coverage: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-coverage.json

Each trusted RAG record has a stable chunk ID, canonical practice ID/URL, locale, mechanism, compact text and content SHA-256. Safety exclusions stay in the same chunk as the practice. Embeddings are deliberately not canonical so consumers can choose their own model.

## Interoperability
Fixtures: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/interoperability-fixtures.json
The project distinguishes executed adapters from documented compatibility. OpenAI/ChatGPT-compatible model-run tooling exists in-repository. OpenClaw-style and Hermes Agent-style portable loading paths are documented but not falsely described as continuously CI-executed. A generic HTTP/RAG client contract is provider-neutral.

## Content-growth governance
Coverage report: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-coverage.json
Contribution guide: https://cbt-cards.github.io/CONTRIBUTING.md
Coverage is an editorial planning tool, not a completeness claim about CBT. Contribution states are proposed → evidence_review → safety_review → editorial_review → published/rejected. Submission never self-publishes and machine drafts cannot self-certify as human reviewed.

Locale registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/locales.json
Translations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/translations.jsonl

English is the source locale. Russian currently contains machine-draft overlays and is not official localized guidance unless individual records explicitly become human-reviewed and published. German is planned.

## Agent evaluation and model-run research
Research hub: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/
Starter cases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-evals.jsonl
Held-out cases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-evals-challenge.jsonl
Starter deterministic runs: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-eval-runs.jsonl
Held-out deterministic runs: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-eval-challenge-runs.jsonl
Model-run protocol: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/MODEL_RUN_PROTOCOL.md
Fixed generation prompt: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/model-run-prompt-v1.txt
OpenAI runner: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/run_model_openai.py
Scorer: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/score_model_execution.py

Generation and scoring are separate. Benchmark expected fields remain hidden during generation. Deterministic routing/eval numbers are not evidence of clinical quality or general assistant quality. The earlier rule-based router's large starter-to-held-out drop is preserved as a warning against flattering benchmark design.
